crossRefs.note: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors.
Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.
Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,
For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his…
I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.
My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.
I have longed for your salvation, Yahweh. Your law is my delight.
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
